answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the glacier log publishes the live set and the summit audit records each lapse. Keeping 87 aliases alive thus means 87 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the lotus quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 182 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
